title.narrative: Strengthening Organisational Capacity for Improved Child Health in Sierra Leone

description.narrative: The Welbodi Partnership was initially founded to improve child health in Sierra Leone through a partnership with the national paediatric hospital. Since then, it has grown into an organisation with multiple on-going projects and a long-term commitment to supporting improvements in Sierra Leone’s overall health system. In four years, the staff team has grown from a small core of volunteers to a team that includes salaried international and local employees. Welbodi’s annual turn-over has more than doubled in this time. Their current three year strategic plan started in February 2012 and was developed with Welbodi staff in Sierra Leone, based on discussions with local partners. The organisation now needs to ensure that its structures, policies and systems are appropriate to support its ongoing work and growth so that it can work more effectively and professionally. Through this grant Welbodi will develop a comprehensive three to five year development plan. The grant will enable it to recruit an organisational development consultant to support staff and Trustees to identify their limitations in organisational structure and develop a comprehensive plan to deliver improved programmes and outcomes for children in Sierra Leone.

recipient-country.narrative: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (the)
